articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Dào zhǎnlǎnguǎn yǒu meiyou zhídáchē?
MR. ANDERSON: Is there a direct bus to the exhibition hall?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Méiyou. Děi zài Xīdān huàn chē.
COMRADE WÁNG: No. You have to change buses at Xīdān.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Dào nǎr qù, zuò jǐlù chē ya?
MR. ANDERSON: What bus do you take to get there?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Zuò Yīlù chē. Zuò dào Xīdān huàn chē.
COMRADE WÁNG: Take the Number 1 bus. Take it to Xīdān and change buses.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zánmen zài nǎr mǎi piào?
MR. ANDERSON: Where do we buy tickets?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Zài chēshang mǎi piào. Hǎo, xiànzài zǒu ba!
COMRADE WÁNG: We buy tickets on the bus. Okay, let's go now!
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Èi! Zánmen bú shi zuòguò zhàn le ba?
MR. ANDERSON: Hey! Haven't we gone past our stop?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Hái méi ne. Xià yízhàn cái xià chē.
COMRADE WÁNG: Not yet. We don't get off until the next stop.
